full_judgment: "That out of 65 rooms the minimum monthly rental will come at Taka 20,000.00 as a result the compensation and mesne profits from the building portions will come to Taka 1,60,000.00 from 2-3-77 to 2-3-1985. The compensation and mesne profits for the vacant portion of the suit land will come to Taka 42,00,000.00 @ Taka 2,00,000.00 per katta since the land has been trespassed and occupied and period of limitation has (sic) over as a result the plaintiff has sustained loss of ownership in the said land; the image of the buildings for willful non-repairing, non-white-washing and hazardous use and occupation by the persons inducted by the defendants in the Houses, if assessed with money value would come to Taka 20,00.00 since the plaintiff is to demolish the same after recovery of possession of it or if the possession is not restored at all. The defendants are also liable to pay @ Taka 20,000.00 as recurring future mesne profits and compensation for the Mesne. Thus the plaintiff is entitled to realise from the defendants a sum of Taka 83,61,000.00 (Taka eighty three lacs, sixty one Thousand) along with monthly Taka 20,000.00 as recurring compensation and the defendants are liable to pay."
